title: Has anyone started to carry a gun around mallworld?
content: Last week, for the first time in mallword, I was armed when I arrived. Throughout the dream I had to fire multiple times and woke up with a very clear sensation of shooting a gun. I want to precise I live in Europe, never handled a firearm, I don't think about it on the regular, don't play videogames, etc... I was defending myself in my dream and it happened a couple of times since, those dreams weren't lucid so I can't really tell more but this new addition is disturbing to me. Mallworld has been very uncomfortable in the past but not THAT threatening. The only thing that has changed is me opening up about my recurring dreams to my friends and reddit. Has anyone had this experience?
